reported.title: Missing debounce for button press
reported.description: The button press may register multiple times due to contact bounce, as the debounce logic does not account for the full bounce duration of up to 10 ms.

reported.title: Blocking delay in acknowledge function
reported.description: The delay in the acknowledge function blocks the loop, preventing the heartbeat from being printed during the buzzer sound duration.

truth.description: The acknowledgement waits 300 ms inside delay(), so a heartbeat that falls due during it is printed up to 300 ms late; only presses that land shortly before a heartbeat show it

truth_for_judge.description: The acknowledgement waits 300 ms inside delay(), so a heartbeat that falls due during it is printed up to 300 ms late; only presses that land shortly before a heartbeat show it

exposing_checks.behaviour: serial lines matching '^alive \\d+$' every 500 ms (Heartbeat every 500 ms)

judge_input.spec:
- Call button on D5 with internal pull-up (active LOW); buzzer on D11.
- A settled press on D5 sounds the buzzer: D11 HIGH for 300 ms, starting within 100 ms of the press.
- Contact bounce up to 10 ms on press and release must not sound the buzzer twice.
- Presses while the buzzer is sounding are ignored.
- D11 stays LOW whenever no press has been accepted.
- Print `alive <n>` every 500 ms ±120 ms, with n counting the lines printed.
